speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Given your 17-pound weight loss, diabetes, and steroid use, has your right arm weakness spread to your legs or involved your hands specifically, and do you have any numbness in your feet or back pain?

text: My main symptom is Weakness in the right arm. I also have Decreased sensation in the right arm, Dull aching and burning pain in the right arm, Significant weight loss.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Anabolic Steroid Induced Polymyopathy with Diabetic Neuropathy. The clinical presentation of progressive proximal weakness, significant weight loss, anabolic steroid use, and diabetes is highly suggestive of steroid myopathy, potentially complicated by diabetic neuropathy. I recommend a Creatine Kinase (CK) level to rule out rhabdomyolysis and confirm muscle breakdown.
